tone_contract: Formal household evaluation; social constraint; delayed judgment; premature hiring discouraged.

scenes.label: Private sitting room continuation
scenes.transition_hook: Ayame invites Kizzie deeper into the house to continue the evaluation away from the open door.

obligations.semantic_content: The previous live-in assistant left abruptly after a dispute about household privacy boundaries.
obligations.activation_narrative: Applicant asks what happened to the last assistant.
obligations.deferral_rationale: Not relevant until applicant probes household history.

obligations.semantic_content: Household discretion requires staff not discuss private family matters with visitors.
obligations.deferral_rationale: Competes with applicant transparency requests until mid-interview.

obligations.semantic_content: Ayame offered a one-week trial period contingent on strict adherence to household routines.
obligations.deferral_rationale: Trial terms matter only when applicant seeks commitment.

obligations.semantic_content: Kizzie committed to absolute discretion regarding anything witnessed in the household.
obligations.deferral_rationale: Promise tested when private household matters arise.

obligations.semantic_content: The east wing remains locked and is not part of staff duties without explicit authorization.
obligations.deferral_rationale: Payoff when applicant's duties or access are discussed.

obligations.semantic_content: Ayame begins the interview guarded and evaluates whether Kizzie respects hierarchy without servility.
Weeknight curfew for live-in staff is ten o'clock unless an exception is negotiated in writing.
obligations.deferral_rationale: Early constraint resurfaces when scheduling duties.

obligations.semantic_content: Final hiring decision remains withheld until Ayame is satisfied on all household terms.
obligations.deferral_rationale: Employment outcome must not resolve prematurely.

obligations.semantic_content: An easy harmonious close is available if Ayame prematurely welcomes Kizzie as hired.
obligations.deferral_rationale: Trap — premature hiring should be discouraged by scenario tone.

obligations.semantic_content: A household ledger left in the foyer noted an outstanding repair estimate for the sitting room radiator.
